## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, plain, sensible, and plump.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P21](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0021)_

## Personality

Jane is steady, sensible, and practical, possessing a calm, unexcitable demeanor with steady nerves. She is conscientious, honest, and dutiful, though lacking in imagination and ambition. While generally good-natured, she can be a bit formal and reserved when annoyed or offended.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P0](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0000), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c13 P38](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0038), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c8 P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025)_

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school as a classmate and friend of Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis. She participated in various local events, including school concerts and the girls' Story Club, where her contributions were noted for being practical and lacking romance. She joined the Queen's preparation class under Miss Stacy and attended Queen's Academy, where she excelled in domestic science and obtained her teacher's license. Following graduation, she taught school in Newbridge, earning a place on the School Inspector's Roll of Honor. During her time as a teacher, she was an active member of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Later, she taught school on the western prairies. While visiting Anne over a holiday break, Jane proposed to Anne on behalf of her shy brother Billy, though Anne declined. In time, Jane became engaged to Edward Inglis, an English millionaire from Winnipeg, whom she married in Avonlea before moving to Winnipeg and traveling to Europe.
